_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Workspace mode shows the exe logo atop the drawer, stock Shelley doesn't. The server starts in workspace mode (the "workspace" feature flag is on); call "workspace off" turns the flag off. On a fresh server the first load of a page in workspace mode takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created: wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. The element ".drawer-header [data-testid='exe-brand']" (the brand) should be visible. 3. The brand's whole text should be exactly "exe". 4. The img inside the brand should load: an eval of document.querySelector(".drawer-header [data-testid='exe-brand'] img").naturalWidth > 0 should become true. 5. The img's rendered width (getBoundingClientRect().width) must be greater than 16: eval that comparison, expecting true. 6. Call "workspace off". 7. Navigate to / again. 8. ".drawer-header" should be visible. 9. There must be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "exe-brand" anywhere on the page.
